thread:
Leah (Product): FYI - AtlasHealth asked for a focused way to connect cost spikes to user flows. Their request: lightweight dashboard + a sampled full-trace capture for a small % of high-cost requests so they can debug token-expensive prefixes.

Shaun (Eng): Clarify "high-cost": are we triggering on token_cost (USD) per request, token count, or something related to model/latency? Need a deterministic rule for runtime.

Maya (Customer Success): Atlas wants token_cost > $0.05 OR response_tokens > 1000. They also want it opt-in for their org first (org-level canary).

Ian (SRE): Reservoir sampling of 1% across fleet is doable but noisy. If we add a threshold filter first (token_cost or tokens), overall volume drops. Concern: full traces are large for long responses - must cap or tag oversize instead of storing raw.

Shaun (Eng): Proposed runtime hook config: 
```
sampling_thresholds:
  response_tokens: 1000
  cost_usd: 0.05
reservoir_rate: 0.01
per_org_canary: true
max_trace_bytes: 512000
redact_keys: ["ssn", "credit_card", "password"]
```
Hook emits full trace + context when thresholds + reservoir hit; otherwise emits metadata only (trace id, route, token_cost). Rate limiter enforces global cap. ETA: 5 dev days for alpha.

Leah (Product): Dashboard MVP (beta):
- timeseries: cost by route (30d)
- table: top N routes by median cost and 90th percentile
- sampled traces list (with link to full trace viewer)
- export (CSV + bundle)
Keep UI simple; customers should find offending routes in one screen.

Maya (Customer Success): Atlas also requires export to their security team and PII redaction controls + consent/approval flow. Initially they want their org only to see samples.

Ian (SRE): Redaction plan: apply key-based scrubbing for common PII keys, drop bodies > 500KB and mark trace as "oversize". We will surface sanitized sample and a flag showing redactions applied. Add an explicit retention/consent flag for customer visibility.

Shaun (Eng): Rollout plan: (1) internal alpha w/ synthetic traffic to validate size & redaction, (2) opt-in beta for AtlasHealth org toggle, (3) 2-week beta, then GA. FF + per-org toggles.

Leah (Product): Draft launch criteria:
- dashboard widgets wired to telemetry
- sampling hook behind FF + per-org toggle
- redaction pass + max-size handling works end-to-end
- E2E tests for privacy/export flows
- cost overhead estimate acceptable (<1.5% billing impact for beta)
- AtlasHealth signs privacy/export flow

Maya (Customer Success): Add rollback guard: Atlas wants auto-disable if their error rate or latency regresses after enabling.

Ian (SRE): Guardrails proposal: if after enabling for an org we detect +0.1% absolute increase in 5xx or p95 latency increase > 30ms within 15m window, automatically disable sampling for that org, notify oncall + CS, and create incident stub.

Shaun (Eng): Storage back-of-envelope: Atlas beta at 1% targeted sampling => ~8GB/day of full traces (text-gen heavy). Will add line-item calc in PR. Need to update customer docs & billing note about incremental storage/ingest.
